$$

$$

$$

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y &=-8 \\ 0x+0y &=6.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

However, the final equation $0x+0y=6$ has no solution. It simplifies to $0=6,$ which is a false statement.

"0075a5c6-0e03-5984-8b49-105838330921" :question/problem "Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-3y &=-4 \\ -12x+36y &=48.\end{aligned}\right.

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system."] [:db/add "0075a5c6-0e03-5984-8b49-105838330921" :question/worked-solution "First, we set up the augmented matrix for the system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -4 \\ -12 & 36 & 48\end{array}\right]
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -4 \\ -12 & 36 & 48\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+12{R}_{1} \\  & \sim\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-3y &=-4 \\ 0x+0y &=0.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Since any pair of numbers $x,y$ is a solution of the final equation $0x+0y=0,$ we can remove this equation from the system. So, our system now consists of a single equation

$$
x-3y=-4.
$$

The first variable $(x)$ is the basic variable, and the second variable $(y)$ is the free variable. Solving for the basic variable $(x)$ in terms of the free variable $(y),$ we get $x=3y-4,$ and the general solution is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x &=3y-4 \\ y &=y\end{aligned}\right.
$$

where $y$ is an arbitrary number.

In vector form, the general solution can be written as

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}3y-4 \\ y\end{bmatrix},\,y\in (-\infty ,\infty ).
